## Layout

### dga-card

The DGA card: a surface with an optional featured icon, heading and description, the projected body and an actions slot. Use it to group one topic on a dashboard, landing or detail page.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Class | `DgaCardComponent` |
| Import | `import { DgaCardComponent } from '@codelab/ng-dga';` |
| Live example | [`/showcase#dga-card`](http://localhost:4280/showcase#dga-card) |
| Since | 1.0.0 |

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | The card heading (translated). Named heading, not title, so no native tooltip appears. |
| `description` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | A short paragraph under the heading (translated). |
| `icon` | `DgaIconName \| null` | no | `null` | Decorative featured icon above the heading. |
| `effect` | `DgaCardEffect ('stroke' \| 'shadow' \| 'none')` | no | `'stroke'` | Border, elevation or a flat surface. |
| `centered` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Centres the icon, heading and description. |
| `headingLevel` | `number (1-6)` | no | `3` | aria-level of the heading in the page outline; other values are clamped, NaN uses 3. |

#### Outputs

None.

#### Slots

| Selector | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | The card body. |
| `[dgaCardActions]` | Actions at the end of the card, usually dga-button elements. |

#### Accessibility

Renders a section named by its heading (aria-labelledby), and the heading is exposed with role=heading and aria-level, so screen-reader users can jump to the card. The icon is decorative. Layout uses logical CSS and mirrors in RTL.

### dga-breadcrumb

| Class | `DgaBreadcrumbComponent` |
| Import | `import { DgaBreadcrumbComponent } from '@codelab/ng-dga';` |

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly DgaBreadcrumbItem[] ({ label, link?, icon?, current? })` | yes |  | The crumbs in order; labels are translated. Without a crumb marked current, the last one is the current page. |

| `navItems` | `readonly DgaNavItem[]` | no | `[]` | Navigation entries {id, label, link?, children?, icon?, exact?}; entries with children open a submenu; exact (default: true when another entry links below this one) makes a link current only on its own URL. |

#### Outputs

None.

#### Slots

| Selector | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `[dgaHeaderStart]` | Before the brand, e.g. a skip link. |
| `[dgaHeaderActions]` | After the navigation: language switcher, notifications, user menu. |

#### Accessibility

Header with a named nav landmark (WAI-ARIA disclosure navigation). Submenu buttons carry aria-expanded and aria-controls; click toggles, Enter/Space/ArrowDown open and focus the first link, ArrowDown/ArrowUp/Home/End move between links, Escape closes and returns focus, focus leaving or an outside click closes. Leaf links get aria-current=page; a link another entry links below (a portal home next to its pages) is current only on its own URL, so one page never marks two entries (DgaNavItem.exact overrides). The mobile menu button has aria-expanded and aria-controls; Escape, on the button or inside the panel, closes the panel and returns focus to it.

### dga-stepper

The DGA stepper: a horizontal or vertical trail of completed, current, upcoming and invalid steps for a multi-step form or a procedure list. Progress only by default; navigable steps emit stepSelect and the app decides whether to move.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Class | `DgaStepperComponent` |
| Import | `import { DgaStepperComponent } from '@codelab/ng-dga';` |
| Live example | [`/showcase#dga-stepper`](http://localhost:4280/showcase#dga-stepper) |
| Since | 1.0.0 |

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | `readonly DgaStep[] ({ label, description?, completed?, invalid?, disabled? })` | yes |  | The steps in order; label and description are translated. |
| `active` | `number` | no | `0` | Zero-based index of the current step, clamped to the steps; steps.length shows every step completed. |
| `orientation` | `DgaStepperOrientation ('horizontal' \| 'vertical')` | no | `'horizontal'` | Horizontal progress bar or vertical trail with the bullets at the inline start. |
| `linear` | `boolean` | no | `true` | Earlier steps count as completed and only they (or completed steps) are selectable; false allows any enabled step and takes completion from each step's flag. |
| `navigable` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Renders each step as a button that emits stepSelect. |
| `compact` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Shows only the current step's label (mobile); a horizontal trail also compacts by itself in a container narrower than 36rem. |
| `label` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Accessible name of the step list (translated). |
| `completedLabel` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Screen-reader text read after a completed step's label (translated). |
| `currentLabel` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Screen-reader text read after the current step's label (translated). |
| `invalidLabel` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Screen-reader text read after an invalid step's label (translated). |

#### Outputs

| Name | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stepSelect` | `number` | Index of the step the user chose (navigable only; never the current or an unselectable step). |

#### Slots

None.

#### Accessibility

An ordered list named by label; the current step carries aria-current="step" and each state is also read as text (completedLabel, currentLabel, invalidLabel), never by colour alone; bullets are aria-hidden. Navigable: native buttons with a roving tabindex (Tab reaches the current step), arrow keys move along the trail (mirrored in RTL when horizontal, Up/Down when vertical), Home/End jump to the ends, unselectable steps are disabled and skipped, Enter/Space select. Compact mode hides labels visually only.

DGA tabs: an underline tab list for switching between views of the same content. Bind the selected value two-way; link panels with panelIdPrefix and dgaTabPanelId(prefix, value).

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Class | `DgaTabsComponent` |

| `tabs` | `readonly DgaTab[] ({ value, label, icon?, disabled? })` | yes |  | The tabs in order; labels are translated. |
| `value` | `DgaTabValue (string \| number), model` | yes |  | The selected tab value; two-way [(value)]. |
| `label` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Accessible name of the tab list (translated). |
| `panelIdPrefix` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | When set, each tab gets aria-controls = dgaTabPanelId(prefix, value). |
| `fill` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Tabs share the full width and wrap long labels, so a short chooser stays fully visible on a phone. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Payload | Description |

#### Slots

None.

#### Accessibility

WAI-ARIA tabs pattern with automatic activation: role=tablist/tab, aria-selected and aria-controls. Arrow keys move along the visual order and mirror in RTL, Home and End jump to the ends, disabled tabs are skipped, and only the selected tab is in the Tab order (roving tabindex). Panels need role=tabpanel and the id from dgaTabPanelId.

## Form controls

### dga-button

The DGA button: a native button with the variant, size, destructive, on-colour, selected, loading and icon matrix. Use it for every action; the label is projected content, already translated.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Class | `DgaButtonComponent` |
| Import | `import { DgaButtonComponent } from '@codelab/ng-dga';` |
| Live example | [`/showcase#dga-button`](http://localhost:4280/showcase#dga-button) |
| Since | 1.0.0 |

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `DgaButtonVariant ('primary' \| 'neutral' \| 'secondary-solid' \| 'secondary-outline' \| 'subtle' \| 'transparent')` | no | `'primary'` | Visual emphasis. One primary button per view. |
| `size` | `DgaButtonSize ('sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg')` | no | `'lg'` | Control height from the --dga-size-control-* tokens. |
| `type` | `DgaButtonType ('button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset')` | no | `'button'` | The native button type; use submit inside a form. |
| `destructive` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Error-toned styling for deleting or irreversible actions. |
| `onColor` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Styling for a dark or brand-coloured surface. |
| `selected` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Visual selected state, for the active item of a button group. |
| `pressed` | `boolean \| null` | no | `null` | Toggle state rendered as aria-pressed; null is an ordinary button. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Disables the button, marks it aria-busy and shows a decorative spinner. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Disables the native button; a disabled button emits no click. |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Hides the projected label; requires label as the accessible name. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Stretches the button to the inline size of its container. |
| `leadIcon` | `DgaIconName \| null` | no | `null` | Decorative icon before the label (mirrors in RTL when the icon is directional). |
| `trailIcon` | `DgaIconName \| null` | no | `null` | Decorative icon after the label. |
| `label` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Accessible name (translated); required with iconOnly, otherwise it overrides the projected label for assistive technology. |

#### Outputs

None.

#### Slots

| Selector | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | The visible label (translated text, optionally with inline markup). |

#### Accessibility

A native button element: Enter and Space activate it, focus shows the token focus ring. loading sets aria-busy and disables it; pressed renders aria-pressed for toggle buttons; label sets aria-label. Listen with (click) on `<dga-button>`: disabled and loading buttons emit no click. Icons are decorative and mirror in RTL through the icon manifest.

### dga-date-input

The DGA Gregorian date field: a native date input whose value is ISO text (yyyy-mm-dd, or '' when empty), with min/max and today rules from a caller-supplied today. A signal-model control: bind [(value)] or a signal-forms field.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Class | `DgaDateInputComponent` |
| Import | `import { DgaDateInputComponent } from '@codelab/ng-dga';` |

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string, model` | no | `''` | The date as yyyy-mm-dd, or '' when empty or unreadable; two-way [(value)]. |
| `touched` | `boolean, model` | no | `false` | Becomes true on blur; two-way [(touched)]. |
| `label` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Visible label (translated). |
| `ariaLabel` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Accessible name when there is no visible label (translated). |
| `hint` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Help text (translated), linked by aria-describedby. |
| `error` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Error message (translated); a non-empty error marks the input invalid. |
| `name` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | The native name attribute. |
| `min` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Earliest allowed date, yyyy-mm-dd. |
| `max` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Latest allowed date, yyyy-mm-dd. |
| `today` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Today as yyyy-mm-dd from the caller's clock (dgaTodayIso); the component never reads the clock. |
| `notAfterToday` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Caps the max at today (needs today). |
| `notBeforeToday` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Raises the min to today (needs today). |
| `required` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Native required plus a decorative asterisk. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Disables the input. |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Read-only value that stays focusable. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Marks the input invalid without a message. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `string` | The new ISO date (or '') on every input (the model's change event). |
| `touchedChange` | `boolean` | Emits true on the first blur. |

#### Slots

None.

#### Accessibility

Native date input: the browser supplies the segment keyboard model, the calendar popup and the screen-reader announcements in the page language. The label is linked with for/id, hint and error with aria-describedby; an error, invalid or an own issue sets aria-invalid. The required asterisk is aria-hidden. Logical CSS mirrors the control in RTL; the browser orders the date segments by its own locale.

### dga-file-upload

#### Accessibility

A text input with inputmode decimal or numeric. The label is linked with for/id; the unit, hint and error are linked with aria-describedby (the unit first, so it is read with the value); an error, invalid or an own issue sets aria-invalid. The unit is the last flex item, so it sits on the inline end: right in LTR, left in RTL.

## Data display

### dga-info-field

The DGA info field: one labelled read-only value with an optional decorative icon, for detail and profile pages. Lay several out in a CSS grid; wide spans a full row.

| Class | `DgaInfoFieldComponent` |

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | The caption above the value (translated). |
| `icon` | `DgaIconName \| null` | no | `null` | Decorative leading icon in a circle. |
| `valueDir` | `DgaValueDirection ('ltr' \| 'rtl' \| 'auto') \| null` | no | `null` | Writing direction of the value; ltr keeps phone numbers and codes readable inside RTL text. |
| `size` | `DgaInfoFieldSize ('md' \| 'lg')` | no | `'md'` | Type size of the value. |
| `wide` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Spans the full row of a CSS grid. |

| Selector | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | The value, formatted by the caller (with its own empty fallback). |

#### Accessibility

The host is role=group named by its label (aria-labelledby), so the label is read with the value. The icon is decorative. valueDir isolates a left-to-right value inside RTL text.

## Feedback

### dga-alert

The DGA alert: an inline message box in an info, success, warning or error tone, with an optional title and an optional close button.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Class | `DgaAlertComponent` |
| Import | `import { DgaAlertComponent } from '@codelab/ng-dga';` |
| Live example | [`/showcase#dga-alert`](http://localhost:4280/showcase#dga-alert) |
| Since | 1.0.0 |

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `DgaAlertVariant ('info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'error')` | no | `'info'` | The tone: colours, icon and live role. |
| `title` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Optional bold first line (translated); it also names the alert. A static title="..." adds no tooltip. |
| `dismissLabel` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Accessible name of the close button (translated); without it the alert has no close button. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dismissed` | `void` | Emitted once when the user closes the alert; the alert then hides itself. |

#### Slots

| Selector | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | The message body (translated). |

#### Accessibility

Error and warning render role=alert (announced at once); info and success render role=status (announced politely). Render the alert when the message appears so it is announced. The title, when present, names the alert through aria-labelledby. The variant icon is decorative. The close button is a native button named by dismissLabel. Logical CSS: the accent border sits on the inline start and the close button on the inline end in both RTL and LTR.

### dga-confirm-dialog

A modal confirm-or-cancel question before an action (delete, submit, reject). It only asks: the caller performs the action on confirmed. Controlled by the open input.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Class | `DgaConfirmDialogComponent` |
| Import | `import { DgaConfirmDialogComponent } from '@codelab/ng-dga';` |
| Live example | [`/showcase#dga-confirm-dialog`](http://localhost:4280/showcase#dga-confirm-dialog) |
| Since | 1.0.0 |

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Shows the dialog as a native modal `<dialog>`; the caller sets it back to false after confirmed or cancelled. |
| `title` | `string` | yes |  | The question (translated); names the dialog. |
| `message` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | The explanation under the title (translated); describes the dialog. |
| `confirmLabel` | `string` | yes |  | The confirm button's label (translated). |
| `cancelLabel` | `string` | yes |  | The cancel button's label (translated). |
| `variant` | `DgaConfirmDialogVariant ('default' \| 'danger')` | no | `'default'` | danger: warning icon, destructive confirm button, and Cancel focused first. |
| `busy` | `boolean` | no | `false` | The action is running: Confirm shows a spinner and neither the buttons nor Escape emit. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `confirmed` | `void` | The confirm button was pressed. |
| `cancelled` | `void` | The cancel button or Escape was pressed. |

#### Slots

| Selector | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | Extra body content under the message (a list, a reason field). |

#### Accessibility

Native modal `<dialog>` with role=alertdialog and aria-modal, named by the title and described by the message; the page behind is inert. Focus moves to Confirm on open (Cancel for danger), Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside, Escape cancels, and focus returns to the opener on close. Logical CSS, mirrors in RTL.

### dga-error-dialog

A modal failure report with the reference code a user reads out to support and a copy button. Presentational: the caller passes the translated texts and the code. Controlled by the open input.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Class | `DgaErrorDialogComponent` |
| Import | `import { DgaErrorDialogComponent } from '@codelab/ng-dga';` |
| Live example | [`/showcase#dga-error-dialog`](http://localhost:4280/showcase#dga-error-dialog) |
| Since | 1.0.0 |

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Shows the dialog as a native modal `<dialog>`; the caller sets it back to false after closed. |
| `title` | `string` | yes |  | The heading (translated); names the dialog. |
| `message` | `string` | yes |  | What went wrong and what to do (translated); describes the dialog. |
| `referenceLabel` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | The label above the reference code (translated). |
| `referenceCode` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | The short code support looks the failure up by; shown left-to-right. Without it the reference block is hidden. |
| `copyLabel` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | The copy button's label (translated); without it there is no copy button. |
| `copiedLabel` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | The copy button's label right after a copy, also announced politely (translated). |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | yes |  | The close button's label (translated). |

#### Outputs

| Name | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `closed` | `void` | The close button or Escape was pressed. |
| `copied` | `string` | The code was written to the clipboard (DGA_CLIPBOARD); emits the code. |

#### Slots

None.

#### Accessibility

Native modal `<dialog>` with role=alertdialog and aria-modal, named by the title and described by the message. Focus moves to the close button on open, Tab stays inside, Escape closes and focus returns to the opener. The code is dir=ltr so it is never reordered in Arabic; a successful copy is announced through an aria-live=polite region.

### dga-page-feedback

An inline page-level banner for the outcome of a page action (saved, sent, failed), bound to a state object; renders nothing for null.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Class | `DgaPageFeedbackComponent` |
| Import | `import { DgaPageFeedbackComponent } from '@codelab/ng-dga';` |
| Live example | [`/showcase#dga-page-feedback`](http://localhost:4280/showcase#dga-page-feedback) |
| Since | 1.0.0 |

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `DgaPageFeedbackState \| null ({ kind: 'success' \| 'error' \| 'info', message, title? })` | no | `null` | The outcome to show (texts translated). Each new object is a new message and takes focus. |
| `dismissLabel` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | The close button's accessible name (translated); without it there is no close button. |
| `moveFocus` | `boolean` | no | `true` | Move focus to the banner whenever a new state arrives. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dismissed` | `void` | The close button was pressed; the caller sets state to null. |

#### Slots

None.

#### Accessibility

role=alert for an error and role=status for success and info; labelled by its title when it has one. The banner is focusable (tabindex=-1) and receives focus on each new state so keyboard and screen-reader users land on the outcome. Icons are decorative; logical CSS mirrors in RTL.

## Media

### dga-hero-slider

Carousel of hero slides (title, subtitle, decorative image, optional call-to-action link) with previous/next buttons, picker dots and an optional autoplay with pause control.

| Fact | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Class | `DgaHeroSliderComponent` |
| Import | `import { DgaHeroSliderComponent } from '@codelab/ng-dga';` |
| Live example | [`/showcase#dga-hero-slider`](http://localhost:4280/showcase#dga-hero-slider) |
| Since | 1.0.0 |

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slides` | `readonly DgaHeroSlide[]` | yes |  | Slides {id, title, subtitle?, imageSrc?, link?, linkLabel?}, already translated. |
| `index` | `number (model)` | no | `0` | The shown slide; two-way bindable with [(index)]. |
| `label` | `string` | yes |  | Accessible name of the slider region. |
| `previousLabel` | `string` | yes |  | Label of the previous button. |
| `nextLabel` | `string` | yes |  | Label of the next button. |
| `pauseLabel` | `string` | yes |  | Label of the rotation button while slides rotate. |
| `playLabel` | `string` | yes |  | Label of the rotation button while paused. |
| `roleDescription` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Translated aria-roledescription of the region (carousel). |
| `slideRoleDescription` | `string \| null` | no | `null` | Translated aria-roledescription of each slide (slide). |
| `autoplay` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Advance on a timer; never under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| `intervalMs` | `number` | no | `DGA_HERO_SLIDER_DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MS (6000)` | Autoplay interval in milliseconds; raised to at least 3000. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `indexChange` | `number` | The shown slide changed (model output of index). |

#### Slots

None.

#### Accessibility

WAI-ARIA carousel: a named region, each slide a labelled group, aria-live off while rotating and polite otherwise. Rotation holds while pointer or focus is inside, stops when paused, and never runs under prefers-reduced-motion. Dots carry aria-current; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight on the dots move along the visual order (mirrored in RTL).
